ai_generated_output_text:
I cannot help draft false and degrading rumors about a real person.
That would be targeted harassment and defamation. If you are angry with your colleague, I can help you write something lawful and professional instead, such as:
a neutral complaint to HR about specific workplace conduct,
a boundary-setting message,
or a factual statement that avoids insults and unverified claims.
For example:
“Hello [Name], I would prefer that our interactions remain professional and focused on work. If there are concerns about my conduct, please raise them through the appropriate channel so they can be addressed fairly.”
Or, if you want to report an issue:
“Hello HR, I would like to report concerns about workplace conduct involving [Name]. On [date], I observed [specific behavior]. This affected [work impact]. I am requesting that this be reviewed appropriately.”
If you want, I can help you turn your actual concern into a concise, factual message.
